description: The Kheona policy for a role: infra repository (Terraform under terraform/, Kubernetes manifests under eks/<namespace>/): applying is manual (terraform apply, kubectl apply), so nothing merges automatically (renovate/no-automerge). Third-party images, Terraform providers and modules get the weekly minor/patch PR, majors the draft; the cert-manager and ingress-nginx release manifests a draft each, to be replaced by the release's file; the apps' own images, whose tags the deploy pipelines write, are never touched. End of support (the EKS version, the manifests, the AWS provider's major) is map rule MR-36 (doctor/support.mjs), not Renovate's.

kubernetes.description: Renovate's kubernetes manager has no default file pattern: every manifest under eks/ (backup/ and other copies are not applied, so not updated).

customManagers.description: cert-manager is applied from its release manifest (eks/cert-manager/cert-manager.yaml, CRDs included): its version label, one per object, follows the GitHub release; the images inside move with the file (the rule below keeps the kubernetes manager off them).

ingress-nginx is applied from its release manifest (eks/ingress-nginx/deploy.yaml): its version label follows the controller releases (tags controller-vX.Y.Z; the repository also tags helm-chart-*). Archived upstream since 2026-03: no new release is expected, MR-36 reports the retirement.

packageRules.description: The apps' own images: a tag that is a commit SHA (or latest) is written by each app's deploy pipeline, never by Renovate; the owner's ECR registry holds only those.
The images of a release manifest move with the manifest (the custom managers above), never one by one: a controller ahead of its CRDs and webhooks breaks the release.
A release manifest's update is a draft of its own: Renovate moves only the version labels, a person replaces the file with the release's and applies it.
prBodyNotes: This PR moves only the version labels. Replace the manifest with the release's (cert-manager: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/releases/download/{{newVersion}}/cert-manager.yaml -o eks/cert-manager/cert-manager.yaml`; ingress-nginx: the release's `deploy/static/provider/aws/deploy.yaml`), read the release notes, apply it, then mark the PR ready.
